results.question: What events are covered under Section I of the policy?
results.expected_answer: Section I covers loss or damage to the insured vehicle caused by events including fire, explosion, self-ignition or lightning; burglary, housebreaking or theft; riot and strike; earthquake; flood, typhoon, hurricane, storm, tempest, inundation, cyclone, hailstorm; accidental external means; malicious act; terrorist activity; transit by road, rail, inland-waterway, lift, elevator or air; and landslide or rockslide.
results.answer:
Based on the provided documents, Section I pertains to "LOSS OF OR DAMAGE TO THE VEHICLE INSURED" [Document 1, Page 2, Section I]. 

The documents mention the following regarding coverage and events under Section I:
* The company will bear the reasonable cost of protection and removal of the vehicle to the nearest repairer and redelivery to the insured (not exceeding in all ` 1500/- in respect of any one accident) in the event that the vehicle is disabled by reason of loss or damage covered under the policy [Document 1, Page 2, Section I].
* The insured may authorize the repair of the vehicle necessitated by damage for which the Company may be liable under the policy, provided certain conditions are met (such as the estimated cost not exceeding ` 500/-, furnishing a detailed estimate to the Company, and giving assistance to ensure necessity and reasonable charges) [Document 3, Page 2, Section I].

The documents also explicitly list what the company shall *not* be liable for under Section I, which includes:
* Consequential loss, depreciation, wear and tear, mechanical or electrical breakdown, failures, or breakages [Document 1, Page 2, Section I].
* Damage to tyres and tubes unless the vehicle is damaged at the same time (in which case liability is limited to 50% of the replacement cost) [Document 1, Page 2, Section I].
* Any accidental loss or damage suffered while the insured or any person driving with the insured's knowledge and consent is under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs [Document 1, Page 2, Section I].
* Each and every claim in respect of the deductible stated in the schedule [Document 2, Page 7, Section DEDUCTIBLE].
